title: Protocol to Culture Cells on Genipin-Mixed Collagen Gels with Different Stiffnesses
author: Ishihara, Haga

steps.title: Culture KP4 cells to subconfluence
steps.instruction: Grow KP4 pancreatic cancer cells in a 6 cm or 10 cm culture dish with DMEM containing 10 % FBS and 1 % antibiotics until the culture is subconfluent.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the subconfluent cells twice with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Trypsinize cells
steps.instruction: Remove PBS, add enough trypsin solution to cover the monolayer, and incubate at 37 °C in a humidified 5 % CO₂ incubator for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect, centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Detach cells by gentle pipetting, transfer them to a centrifuge tube, add an equal volume of DMEM (10 % FBS, 1 % antibiotics) and mix gently; centrifuge at 161 × g for 2 min; discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in fresh DMEM (10 % FBS, 1 % antibiotics) to obtain a uniform suspension; determine cell density and seed 2 × 10⁴ cells in 500 µL of the same medium onto the genipin‑mixed collagen gel placed in a glass dish with a 16 mm inner‑diameter.

steps.title: Incubate seeded cells
steps.instruction: Place the dish with seeded cells in a 37 °C humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂ and culture for 2 days.

steps.title: Fix cells with paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Remove culture media, add 500 µL of 4 % paraformaldehyde, and incubate on a shaker at room temperature (20 °C–25 °C) for 10 min in a draft chamber.

steps.title: Wash after fixation
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS (perform washes in a draft chamber).

steps.title: Permeabilize with Triton X‑100
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 0.5 % Triton X‑100, incubate on a shaker at room temperature (20 °C–25 °C) for 10 min.

steps.title: Wash after permeabilization
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS.

steps.title: Block with skim milk
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 5 % skim milk, incubate on a shaker at room temperature (20 °C–25 °C) for 30 min.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Remove the skim‑milk solution, add 200 µL of primary antibody solution, and incubate on a shaker at 4 °C overnight (12–24 h).

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS.

steps.title: Secondary antibody and nuclear stain
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of secondary‑antibody solution containing Hoechst 33342, incubate on a shaker at room temperature (20 °C–25 °C) for 1 h in the dark.

steps.title: Final washes and PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS, then add 500 µL of PBS.

steps.title: Confocal imaging of ATF5 and nuclei
steps.instruction: Image ATF5 and nuclei using a Nikon C2 confocal microscope with a 60× objective (XY: 1024 pixels, 212.13 µm). Excite nuclei with a 405 nm laser and ATF5 with a 488 nm laser. Avoid orange or red fluorescent dyes because genipin cross‑links emit in the 510–560/590 nm and 590/630 nm ranges.
